title: Standup-lite runtime checkpoints (Arjun personal prep)
body:
Purpose: quick prep for tomorrow's 30m standup with runtime + infra + console leads. This is my lightweight personal scratchpad — use it to call out risks, summarize metrics, and push a few targeted asks. Not formal minutes; will convert action items into Linear after meeting.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick metrics (5m)
   - P95 gen latency (prod): 230ms (up 12ms vs last week) — likely due to longer avg seq length from customer A.
   - Errors: 0.09% token-level errors, spike on Tue (0.4%) tied to PR #1287 deploy (see logs).
   - Throughput: steady at 12k rps, burst handling OK, but cold-starts for small instances still visible.

2) Canary & rollouts (7m)
   - Canary for runtime v1.14 is at 8% traffic. Heatmap: minor async queue backlog for 8-9am PST window.
   - Fallback behavior: INF-342 shows one customer experienced degraded quality during fallback to quantized model; need root cause.
   - Ask: decide whether to pause canary if error >0.2% on any customer segment. (I propose auto-pause rule.)

3) Cost/perf ops (5m)
   - Maya's batching tweak cut per-token GPU time by ~6% in synthetic tests. Need to test on real traffic.
   - Question: enable continuous dynamic batching on nodepool-runtime-2? Pros: lower unit cost. Cons: potential tail latency; confirm SLO impact.

4) Console/Observability quick wins (5m)
   - New trace view for KV cache hits merged to staging. Ask Ellie to add a filter for model-version.
   - Missing: per-route token cost broken out by prompt vs. continuation — useful for customer billing demo.

5) Blockers / escalations (5m)
   - Infra: NVLink driver mismatch on a small # of dedicated hosts (ticket open with infra). Watchlist: host gfx-rt-13.
   - Security: Private deploy onboarding paperwork delayed; contact CS (Sophie) for contract milestone.

6) Parking lot / AOB (3m)
   - Proposal: 1-day spike to evaluate int8 vs q4_0 for 7B models on rtx6000-class nodes.
   - Next week's focus: customer A latency SLA review + plan for dedicated capacity.

Notes / talking points (personal):
- Emphasize SLO guardrails: don't let small batch cost wins erode p95. Need a measurable threshold before enabling dynamic batching.
- For canary, prefer a two-stage rule: health + quality check (prompt set eval) before increasing traffic.
- Mention that PR #1287 needs backout instructions documented in the runbook — saw manual rollback >2x this sprint.
- Remind team to attach short annotated diffs to runtime PRs (perf impact summary).

Action items (I will create Linear tickets after meeting):
- [ ] Arjun: Draft auto-pause canary rule proposal and sample thresholds (due 2024-11-12).
- [ ] Maya: Run batch-tweak A/B on 24h real traffic window and share results (due 2024-11-14).
- [ ] Ellie: Add "model-version" filter to KV cache trace view in staging (due 2024-11-13).
- [ ] Samir: Check NVLink driver inventory and scope affected hosts; escalate to infra ops if >5 hosts (due 2024-11-11).
- [ ] Arjun + QA: Create a small prompt set to evaluate fallback quality for INF-342 (due 2024-11-12).
- [ ] Sophie (CS): Confirm contract milestone date for private deploy onboarding and sync with product (due 2024-11-15).

Risks & Mitigations (short):
- Risk: enabling dynamic batching increases p95 in tail windows. Mitigation: rollback flag + canary limited to low-traffic tiers and monitor p95 in 10-min buckets.
- Risk: canary fallback reduces quality for some customers. Mitigation: add prompt-set evaluation end-to-end before increasing traffic; keep rollback easy.

Stuff to follow up (personal reminders):
- Add cost-per-token delta to weekly report (calc using Maya's numbers).
- Update runbook section for "canary rollback" with exact CLI steps and expected timeline.
- Schedule 1:1 with Maya next week to review batching experiment details (agenda: measurement methods, sampling, risk thresholds).

Questions I want on the call:
- Ellie: how long to add that model-version filter (quick patch or deeper change)?
- Samir: do we have updated host inventory exported to SRE? Which nodes still run older NVLink drivers?
- Maya: can we simulate customer A traffic pattern in staging? Need seq length distribution.

Draft for Slack post (if we need to announce canary pause):
"Heads-up: runtime v1.14 canary hitting slight async queue backlogs in morning window; pausing increment to investigate. We're collecting traces & prompt-set evals; will post follow-up in #infra-runtime when we have rollback confirmation."

End of my personal prep notes — convert action items to Linear, ping owners after meeting.

Misc metadata (for conversion later):
- Meeting time: Tue 09:30 PST, 30m
- Attendees to nudge: Maya, Ellie, Samir, Sophie, QA lead (Jules)
- Expected deliverable this sprint: Canary decision + batching experiment results for next sync.
